personas.name: The Open-Source Maintainer / Research Engineer
personas.goals: Run sustained evaluation pipelines and agent loops without mid-run crashes.
personas.pain_points: Hard API rate limits (15 RPM / 1,500 RPD) break automated workloads. Cannot afford Enterprise tiers.
personas.contribution_behavior: Willing to contribute idle keys to earn dynamic burst multiplier for testing phases.
personas.failure_mode: Quota Jail if evaluation pipeline runs unattended and overconsumes

personas.name: The Indie Hacker / Side-Project Developer
personas.goals: Build and launch weekend projects or indie tools with minimal configuration.
personas.pain_points: Hits rate limits when side project gets initial traction; cannot afford paid API tiers.
personas.contribution_behavior: Contributes a single free-tier key to access the community pool and earn standard multiplier.
personas.failure_mode: Forgets about key rotation grace period; loses vesting tier

personas.name: The Student / Hackathon Builder
personas.goals: Ship hackathon projects fast using state-of-the-art LLMs.
personas.pain_points: Locked out of paid tiers (no international credit card). Needs 24-48h burst capacity.
personas.contribution_behavior: Net consumer initially; contributes whatever free keys they can generate.
personas.pool_preference: Mixed (Private initially, Community when they understand the system)
personas.failure_mode: Confusion around K1/K2 attestation; may abandon if consent flow is unclear
